new_modules.title: Study Protocol Designer
new_modules.summary: Build a complete, reviewable research protocol from objectives through visits, endpoints, deviations and amendments.
workflow: Define the research question and objectives
Lock and export the protocol package
new_modules.boundary: The generated protocol is a planning aid and requires discipline-specific, ethical, legal and statistical review before use in a real study.

new_modules.title: Sample Size & Statistical Power Studio
new_modules.summary: Calculate transparent sample-size scenarios across continuous, binary, survival, repeated-measures and clustered designs.
features: Continuous, binary, count and survival outcomes
new_modules.boundary: Planning calculations depend on assumptions. Confirmatory or regulated studies require a qualified statistician and protocol-specific methods.

new_modules.title: Clinical Trial Design Studio
new_modules.summary: Design phase-aware clinical trials with arms, cohorts, interim decisions, endpoints, recruitment and safety monitoring.
workflow: Model recruitment, dropout and interim rules
new_modules.boundary: This module supports research planning only. Trial design requires ethics, regulatory, clinical, statistical and operational review.

new_modules.title: Experimental Design & DoE Workbench
new_modules.summary: Create and analyse factorial, response-surface, screening and optimal experimental designs for laboratory and process studies.
workflow: Export the randomised run sheet and analysis manifest
new_modules.boundary: DoE outputs are exploratory unless factor ranges, measurement systems, model assumptions and confirmatory runs are prospectively justified.

new_modules.title: Randomization, Blinding & Allocation Studio
new_modules.summary: Generate reproducible allocation schedules with strata, variable blocks, concealment and balance diagnostics.
workflow: Lock concealed and operational exports separately
new_modules.boundary: Production randomisation requires independent control, secure seed and code handling, documented concealment and approved emergency-unblinding procedures.

new_modules.title: Cohort Definition & Eligibility Builder
new_modules.summary: Define reproducible eligibility rules, estimate feasible cohorts and explain every inclusion or exclusion decision.
workflow: Lock and export the cohort definition
new_modules.boundary: Eligibility estimates depend on the quality and representativeness of the source cohort and do not replace clinical adjudication.

new_modules.title: Endpoint & Outcome Strategy Studio
new_modules.summary: Prioritise primary, secondary and exploratory endpoints with burden, validity, missingness and multiplicity controls.
new_modules.boundary: Endpoint selection must be justified by clinical or scientific relevance, measurement validity and a prespecified analysis strategy.

new_modules.title: Biomarker Study Planning Studio
new_modules.summary: Plan diagnostic, prognostic and predictive biomarker studies from discovery through independent validation.
workflow: Lock the analysis and validation roadmap
handoffs: Clinical Trial Biomarker & Patient Stratification Studio
new_modules.boundary: A planning score does not establish biomarker validity. Independent analytical and clinical validation remain required.

new_modules.title: Sampling & Biospecimen Planning Studio
new_modules.summary: Plan collection, aliquoting, storage, shipping and retention for biospecimen-intensive studies.
new_modules.boundary: Volume and storage calculations must be checked against assay-specific requirements, local SOPs, biosafety and biobank constraints.

new_modules.title: Data Collection & CRF Designer
new_modules.summary: Design structured case-report forms, data dictionaries and validation rules across visits and study domains.
new_modules.boundary: A CRF specification requires privacy, security, data-management, clinical and regulatory review before deployment.

new_modules.title: Statistical Analysis Plan Studio
new_modules.summary: Build a versioned statistical analysis plan linking populations, endpoints, models, covariates, multiplicity and sensitivity analyses.
workflow: Map endpoints to models and estimands
Review, lock and export the SAP
new_modules.boundary: The SAP must be reviewed and approved before unblinded outcome analysis and must reflect protocol, estimand and regulatory requirements.

new_modules.title: Research Feasibility & Recruitment Planner
new_modules.summary: Forecast enrolment, screen failures, site activation, dropout, cost and study-completion probability.
workflow: Select sites and export the feasibility package
new_modules.boundary: Recruitment forecasts are scenario-based estimates and must be updated with real site data, competing studies and operational constraints.

new_modules.title: Research Timeline, Milestones & Dependencies Studio
new_modules.summary: Plan tasks, dependencies, critical paths, resources and risk-adjusted timelines across a research programme.
workflow: Export the baseline and risk-adjusted roadmap
new_modules.boundary: Schedule estimates depend on accurate dependencies, resource availability and external approvals. They are not contractual commitments.

new_modules.title: Research Risk & Mitigation Planner
new_modules.summary: Identify, score, mitigate and monitor scientific, statistical, assay, data and operational research risks.
workflow: Monitor residual risk and export the register
new_modules.boundary: Risk scoring supports prioritisation but does not replace domain expert judgement, safety management or organisational governance.

new_modules.title: Evidence Gap & Literature Planning Studio
new_modules.summary: Map existing evidence, contradictions and unanswered questions to justify and prioritise new research.
workflow: Prioritise research and export the search plan
new_modules.boundary: Evidence maps depend on the completeness and quality of the imported literature inventory and do not constitute a systematic review by themselves.

new_modules.title: Pre-Registration & Reproducibility Studio
new_modules.summary: Lock hypotheses, outcomes, exclusions, sample-size rationale and analysis decisions before observing study outcomes.
workflow: Lock the protocol and analysis plan
new_modules.boundary: A preregistration package improves transparency but does not guarantee methodological quality, ethical approval or successful replication.
